/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 - <<'PY'
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlsplit
from solution import patch_query

def check(url, updates, expected):
    result = patch_query(url, updates)
    before, after = urlsplit(url), urlsplit(result)
    assert (after.scheme, after.netloc, after.path, after.fragment) == (before.scheme, before.netloc, before.path, before.fragment), result
    assert parse_qsl(after.query, keep_blank_values=True) == expected, result

check('https://User:pw@Example.invalid:8080/a%2Fb?a=1&b=&a=2&bare#f%20x', [], [('a','1'), ('b',''), ('a','2'), ('bare','')])
check('/p?a=1&b=2&a=3&c=4#frag', [('a',''), ('b',None)], [('c','4'), ('a','')])
check('?%61=1&A=2&a=3&x=4', [('a','5')], [('A','2'), ('x','4'), ('a','5')])
check('../relative?x=0#frag', ((k,v) for k,v in [('a','1'), ('x','2'), ('a',None), ('a','3'), ('absent',None)]), [('x','2'), ('a','3')])
text = '雪 space &+%= café'
updates = [(text, text), ('empty','')]
original = updates.copy()
check('//example.invalid/path#part', updates, [(text,text), ('empty','')])
assert updates == original
check('?a+b=1&a%2Bb=2&=3', [('a b', None), ('','')], [('a+b','2'), ('','')])
check('', [], [])
check('/path?x=1&x=2', [('x',None), ('x',None)], [])
print('8 additional requirement checks passed; updates input unchanged.')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git diff -- solution.py; git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "cat solution.py; python3.12 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
source = Path('solution.py').read_text()
assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in source.splitlines())
compile(source, 'solution.py', 'exec')
print('Final source reviewed; syntax and whitespace checks passed.')
PY"
